title: Dragon feels his late father's presence on the ranch

tellings.quote: he's had experiences on the property where he's felt his father's presence,

plain: A man named Bryant Arnold, known as Dragon, has felt his late father's presence on Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells Michels this as something Dragon told him, saying Dragon has "felt his father's presence" there, which would add the dead to the ranch's list of odd experiences.
